messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — Marigold private rollout currently scheduled 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC via deploybot. Their KMS rotation overlaps the window. @Rita P @Sam T can you triage?

deploybot: planned rollout: project=marigold-private version=v1.13.0 target=production schedule=2026-04-05T02:00Z canary=10% duration=20m. To run: `/deploy start marigold-private --version v1.13.0`

Rita P: Confirmed — KMS rotation ticket #INC-8421 kicks at 2026-04-05 01:45 UTC in eu-west-1, expected ~10m. Key IDs will be rotated; control-plane secret fetches may fail briefly. I recommend we not start canary during rotation.

Priya G: Marigold asked for quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC, they can't move it later. Customer says they can tolerate a small delay but prefer within that window. Need a fallback/guard plan: pin to previous runtime and an explicit rollback play.

Tom L: Infra note: we can add a `--kms-fallback` flag to deploybot which toggles using cached key material for secret reads. If set true, deploy will attempt cached decrypt on first failure and surface alerts. Also can set `canary=0` while rotation is ongoing.

Alex M: Proposal: delay actual start to 02:10 UTC (give KMS rotation time to finish), run a 5% canary for 15m, preflight secret-read smoke test, and set an automated rollback threshold of 5% 5xx within 10m. If KMS errors observed, manual rollback to v1.12.0 (customer requires explicit consent).

deploybot: guard note: canary_rollback_threshold configured = 5%_5xx_10m. Warning: automated fallback to older version is disabled for KMS-related decrypt errors unless `--kms-fallback=true`. Add `--preflight-cmd` to perform secret-read check.

Sam T: Oncall can cover the window. I can stand by from 01:50-03:30 UTC. Recommend we schedule start at 02:10 and hold if any KMS errors during preflight. I'll monitor latency and 5xx rates and be ready to trigger rollback.

Wei Z: CS checked with Marigold SRE — they can accept a 02:10 start but want ability to abort at 02:20. They also requested a short release note blurb and a rollback playbook snippet in advance.

Alex M: Finalized plan: schedule=2026-04-05T02:10Z, canary=5% duration=15m, preflight runs: health + kms decrypt; flags: `--kms-fallback=true`. Rollback command pinned: `/deploy rollback marigold-private --to v1.12.0`. I'll update ops and post release notes 30m prior.

Priya G: :thumbsup: I'll inform customer and attach rollback playbook. @Tom L can you add preflight script to deploybot?

Tom L: Preflight snippet (I'll add to deploybot config):
```
# preflight
curl -fsS https://marigold-priv.internal/health || exit 1
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://secret.bin --region eu-west-1 || exit 2
```
I'll push the change and link the config PR here.

Alex M: Thanks — @deploybot please reschedule to 2026-04-05T02:10:00Z. I'll post short release note in #product-ops 30m before.

deploybot: schedule updated by Alex M. Next run: 2026-04-05T02:10:00Z.

Sam T: I'll be watching dashboards and logs. Page me via PagerDuty if error rate >= 3% or if automated guard trips.

Wei Z: I'll send the customer-facing note now and attach rollback steps.
